title.zh: 为美利坚合众国货币一百零六千二百一十二美元七十六美分（或其中必要部分）拨款，用于支付1902年6月30日结束的财政年度内岛屿政府及马尼拉市某些开支的法案
title.en: AN ACT APPROPRIATING THE SUM OF ONE HUNDRED AND SIX THOUSAND TWO HUNDRED AND TWELVE DOLLARS AND SEVENTY-SIX CENTS, IN MONEY OF THE UNITED STATES, OR SO MUCH THEREOF AS MAY HE NECESSARY, FOR CERTAIN EXPENSES OF THE INSULAR GOVERNMENT, AND OF THE CITY OF MANILA, FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDING JUNE THIRTIETH, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND TWO.
title.orig: AN ACT APPROPRIATING THE SUM OF ONE HUNDRED AND SIX THOUSAND TWO HUNDRED AND TWELVE DOLLARS AND SEVENTY-SIX CENTS, IN MONEY OF THE UNITED STATES, OR SO MUCH THEREOF AS MAY HE NECESSARY, FOR CERTAIN EXPENSES OF THE INSULAR GOVERNMENT, AND OF THE CITY OF MANILA, FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDING JUNE THIRTIETH, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND TWO.
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp ngân sách số tiền một trăm sáu nghìn hai trăm mười hai đô la Mỹ và bảy mươi sáu xu, bằng tiền tệ Hoa Kỳ, hoặc phần cần thiết tương ứng, để chi trả một số khoản chi tiêu của Chính phủ Đảo và Thành phố Manila trong năm tài chính kết thúc vào ngày 30 tháng 6 năm 1902
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดสรรงบประมาณจำนวนหนึ่งแสนหกพันสองร้อยสิบสองดอลลาร์สหรัฐและเจ็ดสิบหกเซนต์ในสกุลเงินสหรัฐอเมริกาหรือจำนวนที่จำเป็นเท่านั้นสำหรับรายจ่ายบางประการของรัฐบาลหมู่เกาะและนครมะนิลาในปีงบประมาณสิ้นสุดวันที่๓๐มิถุนายนพุทธศักราช๒๔๔๕
title.id: Undang-Undang mengalokasikan jumlah sebesar seratus enam ribu dua ratus dua belas dolar Amerika Serikat dan tujuh puluh enam sen, dalam mata uang Amerika Serikat, atau sejumlah yang diperlukan, untuk biaya tertentu Pemerintah Insular dan Kota Manila untuk tahun fiskal yang berakhir pada 30 Juni 1902
title.ms: Akta menyediakan peruntukan sebanyak seratus enam ribu dua ratus dua belas dolar Amerika Syarikat dan tujuh puluh enam sen dalam mata wang Amerika Syarikat atau jumlah yang diperlukan bagi perbelanjaan tertentu Kerajaan Insular dan Bandar Manila bagi tahun kewangan berakhir pada 30 Jun 1902

text.en:
The following sums, in money of the United States, or so much thereof as may be respectively
necessary, are hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for
the purposes and objects hereinafter named, for the fiscal year ending June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and
two: For miscellaneous expenses incurred for the benefit of the Government of the Philippine Islands in the
United States, fifty thousand dollars.
UNITED STATES PHILIPPINE COMMISSION.
Expenses of civil employees not otherwise provided for, United States Philippine Commission,
nineteen hundred and two: For salaries of employees appointed, in the United States to the
Philippine civil service while traveling from the United States to the Philippine Islands, for the
actual and necessary traveling expenses and subsistence of such employees while en route, for
salaries of provincial officers transferred from one province to another during the time
necessarily occupied in making the transfer as provided in Act Numbered Three hundred and
twenty, section one (a), three thousand dollars.
BUREAU OF PHILIPPINES CONSTABULARY.
Commissary stores, Bureau of Philippine Constabulary, nineteen hundred and two: For the
purchase and transportation of commissary stores, forty-two thousand five hundred and eighty-
one dollars and twenty-two cents.
CITY OF MANILA.

Salaries and wages, Department of Police, city of Manila, nineteen hundred and two: For
salaries of special policemen during the cholera epidemic, ten thousand six hundred and thirty-
one dollars and fifty-four cents.
Total of appropriations for all purposes, one hundred and six thousand two hundred and twelve
